description: text-wrap: pretty as Chromium 153 lays it out (Blink's LineBreakStrategy: the score line breaker on the last four lines of each paragraph whose greedy last line is a single word shorter than a third of the width): a centred heading, a long paragraph (only its end rebroken), one line (unchanged), justified text (no line penalty), a text-indent, forced breaks (pre-line: each paragraph on its own), preserved spaces (pre-wrap), bold, larger and bordered inline elements, the text-wrap-style longhand with letter spacing, a long last line in a narrow box (greedy), a pretty span in a greedy paragraph (ignored: the block container decides), and text and class changed at run time, then scrolled so that every paragraph is on screen in some step. Chromium breaks 7 of the 12 pretty paragraphs differently from greedy wrapping at 420px and 7 at 800px. The last word of each paragraph has an id, so geometry checks where the lines break
